records.title: Records
records.metaDescription: The best mark at every standard ultra distance, women and men side by side, with the age classes and who ratified each record.
records.leadWorld: The best mark at each standard distance, women and men side by side. The IAU and GOMU ratify world records; where they have not, the mark is the best in DUV's database.
records.leadArea: Best marks by runners from {area} in DUV's database. The IAU ratifies area records at 50 km, 100 km and 24 h only.
records.leadNation: Best marks by runners from {country} in DUV's database. Not an official list: national federations ratify records.
records.trailNote: Records are kept for standard distances (road, track, indoor) and backyard only. Trail races have none: they compare by time and place within each race.
records.popRatifiedOnly: Ratified by the {body}. DUV's lists hold no mark as good as this one.
records.popPending: Best in DUV's database. An application is with the {body} for ratification.
records.popDuvBest: Best in DUV's database, not ratified by the {body}.
records.popArea: Best in DUV's database. The IAU keeps area records at 50 km, 100 km and 24 h only.
records.popNation: Best in DUV's database. National federations ratify national records.
records.popNone: Best in DUV's database. No body ratifies this record.
records.legendNation: best in DUV per age class; national federations ratify
records.legendPick: Pick a distance for its age classes.
records.detailAside: Women and men side by side
records.shaded: Shaded: the mark that is also the open record.
records.noAgeClasses: DUV keeps no age class lists here.
records.detailFailed: The age classes did not load.

records.emptyFiltered: No marks with these options. Try all surfaces.
